title: knowledge.retrieve_result (v1)
description: KnowledgeIndexAgent's reply to knowledge.retrieve_requested: the matching IndexEntry items, ranked by its retrieval backend, plus the number of hits.

query.description: The query this result answers (echoed from knowledge.retrieve_requested).

entries.description: Matching IndexEntry items, ranked by the retrieval backend.

path_or_ref.description: Path or opaque ref identifying the indexed artifact.

type.description: Kind of artifact being indexed (e.g. literature_brief, code, evidence).

summary.description: Short human-readable summary of the artifact.

tags.description: Free-form tags. Empty array if none.

source.description: Where this entry originated (e.g. emitting agent or artifact kind).

produced_by_state.description: State-machine state active when this entry was produced.
